prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: transparent PNG single burger image for a Korean hamburger tournament. Create a new original realistic studio food cutout accurately depicting Mom's Touch 인크레더블버거 (Incredible Burger). I visually checked the actual official Mom's Touch Instagram promotional product photograph, reproduced with explicit attribution to instagram 'momstouch.love' in the 2018 launch article https://web.insight.co.kr/news/190793, at image https://img.insight.co.kr/static/2018/11/13/700/icaa3rf37e7mi1l2a89n.jpg. The official order menu description confirms egg fry, premium double ham and whole chicken thigh patty. Use this photographed construction, not a generic burger. One complete tall substantial burger centered on a square canvas, whole burger visible with small transparent margins, nearly frontal with very slight three-quarter angle, realistic catalog food photography matching other clean burger cutouts. EXACT layers top to bottom: a glossy golden sesame-seed top bun; ruffled fresh green lettuce; green crinkle-cut pickle slices; thick white onion rings; TWO thin pink smooth deli-ham slices folded to make curled edges (not bacon); ONE round fried egg, white rim lightly golden at edges and visible yellow yolk area; EXACTLY ONE thick irregular whole boneless chicken THIGH fillet with craggy flaky golden-brown crispy breading; a modest pale white herb-speckled creamy sauce layer; lightly toasted bottom bun. The chicken is one thick whole fillet, not ground beef or shrimp, not a double patty. Preserve the egg between ham and chicken. No tomato, cheese, bacon, middle bun, second egg or second chicken patty. Appetizing but realistic proportions, diffuse professional lighting and natural texture. Newly generated depiction rather than copied photo. Genuine transparent alpha background, no brown haze, halo or vignette, no background, ground, plate, board, packaging, wrapper, text, logos, watermark, fries or other objects.
